integrity: Universal proof via rank-conditioned nilpotence and first moment of the kernel; exact exhaustive finite checks supplied separately. No independent audit claimed.
scientific_limitations: Only independent uniform finite-field factors in a cyclic composable product, t>=3; not a nilpotency-index distribution. Wästlund (2020) already covers t=2, and a possible implicit multipartite martingale extension is an originality risk.
title: An exact nilpotency law for cyclic products of at least three random finite-field matrices
